text: well, the values should be adjustable from the game configuration menus we have really. if you can give me all the capability to control how strong it is i can handle the values, just default to something sane
resolution: User asked to control the camera (esp. how strong the wall push-in is) from the settings menu, handling the values themselves with sane defaults. The spring-arm strength knobs already lived in the auto-listed 'play-camera-occlusion' tunable cluster; cleaned it to the live knobs only (minDistanceMeters push-in floor widened to 0.3..6, wall gap, push-in speed, probe thickness, ramp tol) and dropped the dead fade knobs (residualOpacity/maxHits/playerTargetHeightMeters) left over from removing the fade. Added a new 'play-camera-feel' cluster exposing the previously-hardcoded base camera (distance, fov, look height, pitch up/down limits, look sensitivity X/Y): PLAYER_CAMERA is now a live write-through table, pitch limits + sensitivity read live in applyLook, and Embodied.resendCameraParams() (called from PlayRoute onFrame on a tunables-revision change) re-pushes distance/fov/height so edits land the same frame. Defaults unchanged. JS-only, hot-reloads. Verified bundles + settings 8/8 + cameraOcclusion 3/3. Commit a30a3a79c.
